generation.scope: A finite-edge standard candidate is regular with the identities of three-by-three matrices at one single corner if and only if it is an ordinary Clifford window from a basepoint-free web with finite rank-at-most-two locus. No identity bound at the other three corners and no semiprimeness hypothesis are needed. Two-endpoint matrix compression and the Segre inequalities reduce all mixed simple dimensions to the universal extensions already excluded.

open_mathematics: Analyze regular finite windows with a single four-matrix corner, including mixed dimension vectors, and identify uncovered components beyond polynomial-identity criteria.
